lines.text: He built this by talking to AI.
A month later, he can't explain how the app works.
The answer is in one of a hundred and twenty chats.
lines.caption: The answer is in one of 120 chats.

lines.text: I read the agent logs on his Mac, and I remember how each project was built.
lines.hl: remember how each project was built

lines.text: When he corrects an agent twice, it becomes a rule. Nobody asked him.
Then I call him and ask.
Tell me about Hack Nation. What do you remember?
And every agent he uses gets the same memory. Before it breaks one of his rules, it is stopped. In his own words.
lines.hl: the same memory|it is stopped|In his own words.

lines.text: He did not record this video. He was tired. I was there.
lines.say: [lightly amused] He did not record this video. He was tired. I was there.

lines.text: Apprentice. Learning by doing, without the forgetting.
